moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Their track 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Singles Chart's number one spot for a record-breaking 23 non-consecutive weeks, the longest-running #1 ever.

angles.name: Chart Dominance
angles.copy: Still at number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just broke the record for the longest-running UK number one single. History makers.

angles.name: Unstoppable Hit
angles.copy: 23 weeks at the top! Is 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean the greatest chart topper of all time? Discuss.

angles.name: Timeless Tribute

angles.name: Chart Legacy
angles.copy: The power of a timeless song. Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' re-enters the charts at #9, proving her enduring legacy.
